purpose: Fixed-sample diagnostic of the existing leaf-image heuristic; not a calibrated eligibility model or new blind disease benchmark.
production_algorithm: Unchanged OR rule: color coverage below 15% or no plant-related ImageNet top-5 class flags the image.

positive_source.selection: All 236 image blobs under test/ in the pinned upstream classification repository. Keep original per-class filenames and Git blob identities.
positive_source.scope: Source-labelled cropped leaf photographs, not independently agronomist relabelled; this repository snapshot differs from the Kaggle mirror used in historical model evaluation.

negative_source.selection: First 30 JPGs per category ordered by ascending SHA-256 of the category/filename string. Categories are primary-object, non-leaf cases; sunflower separately tests a plant subject outside the leaf-classification task.
negative_source.scope: 300 natural object photographs; source category is a proxy for dominant non-leaf subject, not a pixel-level guarantee of no leaves. Potential ImageNet overlap is not excluded.

additional_diagnostic: All 18 bundled canopy RGB tiles, separate from Caltech counts: aerial crop scenes are outside the single-leaf disease task even though they contain plants.
processing: Decode original bytes, record original dimensions, make an evaluation copy with PIL thumbnail(max 1024x1024), preserve aspect ratio, then use current core inference. Record resizing, decoding failures and exact decoded-image duplicates. Do not silently exclude examples based on predictions.
metrics: Flagged source-labelled leaf count and false-flag rate
Accepted non-leaf count and false-accept rate
Unflagged non-leaf cases with forced disease confidence >=0.5
threshold_policy: Do not tune thresholds, class keywords, checkpoint or source selection on this diagnostic. Any follow-up uses this as inspected development evidence and requires independent validation before claims.
limitations: Near duplicates and ImageNet pretraining overlap unverified
No disease-label accuracy or overall OOD certification claimed
